contentList.content: Nere is guarded by [1] Psionic Visages. He cannot be moved while a visage stands, and the visages return [2] rounds after the last one breaks.

Affected entity is Immune to[1],[2] and[3] and cannot be moved while a Psionic Visage stands.

When the caster is struck, a visage will Shatter, striking the attacker directly.
